tasks.title: C-001: Fix tenancy scope bypass and raw-SQL household_id leaks
acceptance: No prisma.<model>.findUnique on a household-scoped model can return a row from another household; covered by new unit test asserting cross-tenant isolation.
acceptInvite end-to-end test passes — invite created in H1, accepted by user with no active household; raw queries in listMembers and resolveUserAvatarAttachmentId include household_id predicate.
isPlainIdLookup returns false for any where clause containing fields other than id.
tasks.notes: Most dangerous finding in the batch. The findUnique bypass at lines 176-186 allows cross-tenant reads on all 13 household-scoped models. Fix first; task-002 tests must depend on this fix being in place.

tasks.title: C-002: Rewrite tautological invariant tests and add missing coverage
acceptance: No if (!threw) … else patterns remain in invariant tests; all cross-tenant assertions use expect(...).rejects.
pnpm --filter api test -- --coverage runs and emits v8 coverage report with lines/branches thresholds at 60 enforced across all three workspace vitest.config.ts files.

New test files exist: soft-delete/middleware-filter.test.ts (deleted row filtered from findMany), idempotency/expired-key-replay.test.ts (expired key causes handler re-run), tenancy/nullable-tenant.test.ts, and hmacRefresh cases in security/hashing.test.ts.
tasks.notes: Depends on task-001 so tests can assert the tenancy fix actually works. Coverage thresholds added here are enforced by CI after task-014 adds the root pnpm test script.

tasks.title: C-003: NestJS bootstrap, env validation, and logging hygiene
acceptance: SIGTERM triggers onModuleDestroy (verifiable via boot log 'Prisma disconnected'); request body > 1 MB returns 413; boot fails fast if WEB_URL is missing or non-URL.
No console.log/console.error calls exist in apps/api/src/** (enforced by lint rule); crossTenant log entries are at debug level with no stack field.
Production stack traces never appear in API responses or info-level logs (http-exception.filter.ts gates stack logging behind NODE_ENV !== 'production').
tasks.notes: task-008 (correlation ID) depends on this being merged first because request-context middleware needs the DI-aware setup established here.

tasks.title: C-004 (API): Fix error envelope leakage — filter logging, storage scrubbing, Zod code, raw throws
acceptance: All 5xx responses are logged with level=error and correlation ID; storage error responses contain only { op } in details with raw S3 message logged server-side only.

Zod validation responses carry code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'; grep -r 'throw new Error' apps/api/src returns no matches in domain services (bills/cycle.ts, transfers/transfers.service.ts replaced with AppError).
Email-change OTP and auth OTP share the AUTH_OTP_* code namespace.
tasks.notes: Split from C-004 — this is the API half. Web half is task-004b. No dep on task-004b; both can run in parallel.

tasks.title: C-004 (Web): Fix auth UI reading error.message instead of error.code
acceptance: Web auth UI branches on (error as ApiRequestError).code and selects localized strings; it never renders the raw server message field.
Unknown error codes show a generic localized fallback string.
Vitest or Playwright test asserts localized message renders for at least two known codes and that generic fallback renders for an unknown code.
tasks.notes: Narrow jarvis-react spot-check on apps/web/src/routes/auth.tsx is sufficient at re-review; full react re-audit not required.

tasks.title: C-005 + C-012: Fix Liquibase rollback correctness and changeset hygiene
acceptance: liquibase rollbackCount 2 against a populated DB succeeds without type-mismatch or unique-constraint errors; rollback YAML for the idempotency changeset contains an explicit data-loss comment.
Forward addColumn request_hash is idempotent — columnNotExists precondition guards re-run; DEFAULT '' removed from the column definition.

Idempotency changeset contains only idempotency-related operations; sessions/email_change_requests truncations are extracted to a new standalone changeset (20260501-001a) with rollback no-op and data-loss comment.
tasks.notes: C-012 merged into this task — both touch the same changeset file. task-001a (new file) is the extracted truncation changeset created here.

tasks.title: C-006: Add idempotency plumbing to createHousehold client wrapper and hook
acceptance: useCreateHousehold mutation auto-generates an idempotency key on each invocation via onMutate: ensureKey.
Replay of the same (userId, key) returns the cached response without creating a second household row.
Web e2e test asserts double-submit of household creation produces exactly one household row in the DB.
tasks.notes: packages/core is consumed first by web in this case; assignee is frontend-react. Depends on task-001 because the household creation path must be tenancy-clean before idempotency semantics are meaningful.

tasks.title: C-007: Security hardening — HSTS, trust proxy, OTP throttle atomicity, invite-token HMAC
acceptance: Production response headers include Strict-Transport-Security; throttler reads correct client IP behind a proxy (test sending x-forwarded-for header verifies correct IP extraction).
Concurrent OTP-request test cannot produce more accepted OTPs than the per-email rate limit allows (atomic upsert/advisory-lock pattern verified).
Invite tokens are stored as HMAC (hmacRefresh or dedicated hmacInviteToken); a DB-only attacker cannot forge a valid token.
tasks.notes: No deps — security primitives are self-contained. HSTS gated behind NODE_ENV === production check.

tasks.title: C-008: Correlation ID propagation, DI-aware pipe/filter, dead throttler bucket, Redis throttler
acceptance: ZodValidationPipe and HttpExceptionFilter are registered via APP_PIPE/APP_FILTER providers and receive injected Logger/ConfigService instances.
Every API response carries x-correlation-id header; structured logs include the correlation ID for every request.
The dead global throttler bucket is removed; throttler storage is Redis-backed in non-test environments or the single-pod constraint is documented in decisions.md.
tasks.notes: Depends on task-003 because the DI-aware filter setup builds on the logging/ConfigService groundwork laid there.

tasks.title: C-009 (API): Fix idempotency liveAndCache fire-and-forget race condition
acceptance: liveAndCache inserts an in-flight marker row before handler execution (or wraps handler + cache write in a single transaction with unique-constraint catch).
Concurrent-request test confirms only one handler execution occurs per (userId, key) even under parallel load.
tasks.notes: Race fix is backend-only and has no contract dependency. OpenAPI enum update is task-009b.

tasks.title: C-009 (Contract): Add IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID to OpenAPI ErrorCode enum and regen client
acceptance: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID is present in the ErrorCode enum in packages/contracts/openapi.yaml.
Generated TypeScript client recognizes IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID as a typed error code value.
tasks.notes: Depends on task-009a so the backend implementation and contract stay in sync.

tasks.title: C-010: Audit trail — EventType registry, missing audit columns, dropped user events
acceptance: All prisma.event.create calls in apps/api/src use EventType constants from packages/core/src/events/types.ts — enforced by TypeScript compile-time check or lint rule.
New Liquibase changeset adds updated_by to bill_payments and attachments, and deleted_at/created_by/updated_by to loan_lump_sums; columns are NULLable (no backfill required).
recordUserEvent persists user-scoped events (e.g. user.email_changed) without a householdId instead of dropping them; test asserts event is recorded for a user with no household membership.
tasks.notes: Eight service files emitting events need updating to use EventType constants — full list in originating audit findings. New file packages/core/src/events/types.ts is shared-core but backend-nest owns it in this fix since the primary consumer is the API.

tasks.title: C-011: Add hot-path indexes for transactions and FK columns
acceptance: New Liquibase changeset 20260501-003-phase-11-indexes.yaml adds indexes on transactions(account_id), transactions(category_id), transactions(household_id, occurred_at DESC), bill_payments(transaction_id), and budget_threshold_notifications(notification_id).
EXPLAIN on the canonical transactions list query shows the composite (household_id, occurred_at) index being used.
Forward apply and rollbackCount 1 both succeed without error.
tasks.notes: Standalone changeset with no deps. Small and safe to parallelize with all other tasks.

tasks.title: C-013: Remove OTP security-reset oracle and crossHousehold flag from anonymous wrapper
acceptance: verifyOtpForSecurity returns AUTH_OTP_INVALID with no details field distinguishing too_many_attempts from wrong-code — no binary oracle remains.
The verifyOtpForSecurity client wrapper in packages/core/src/api/client.ts does not declare crossHousehold: true.
tasks.notes: The client.ts change is minimal — remove one flag. The API change is also small — remove the reason field from the error details object.

tasks.title: C-014: Add root pnpm test script and canonicalize/random utility coverage
acceptance: pnpm test from repo root runs all workspace test suites (root package.json has 'test': 'pnpm -r test').
New test files exist: apps/api/test/idempotency/canonicalize.test.ts (covering canonicalize and canonicalJSON) and apps/api/test/security/random.test.ts (covering randomOtp and randomToken).
No 'as any' casts remain in test files under apps/api/test/audit/**; MailService stubs are typed against the interface.
tasks.notes: Depends on task-002 so the coverage thresholds are in place before the root script wires everything together and CI starts enforcing them end-to-end.

tasks.title: C-015: Record deferred architectural decisions in decisions.md
acceptance: decisions.md records the open @CurrentUser shape question (active-household resolution at JWT layer vs. per-request context middleware) with an assigned owner and target resolution date.
decisions.md records the crossTenant() proxy semantics question (bare PrismaClient vs. extended Proxy) with rationale and owner.
tasks.notes: No code change — decisions.md append only. No deps. Surfaces architectural questions to the lead for resolution before next sprint.
